title: Uninstall
note: Project uninstall removes exact installer-owned checkout registration and folder trust only with exclusive ownership proof, including trust granted to the checkout's lanes, the Codex hook trust install minted for the checkout's hooks file and the copies mirrored onto its lanes. Shared, modified and unknown entries are preserved. The removal commit records only files Git already tracked, so ignored local views stay out of history and strategy documents stay on disk untracked; partial cleanup retains its manifest and reports recovery. Machine uninstall remains a separate operation.
